market_question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
reasoning: In a 32-team league, even top pre-season contenders rarely exceed a 10–12% chance to win the Cup. The market-implied 37.5% is extreme and likely driven by recent trade excitement; the true probability is closer to 10%. This yields a massive edge for No.
evidence_points: Historical pre-season Stanley Cup futures show the highest single-team implied probability is typically around 10–12%.
Carolina faces significant roster uncertainty, particularly the pending free agency of Mikko Rantanen.
The 2025–26 season is a year away; long-term futures are notoriously noisy, and current market price heavily overrates one team.
